content.text: *MC infects urethra, cervix, anal canal, conjunctiva, or pharynx
*be sure to think of gonococcal pharyngitis in anyone w/ persistent pharyngitis, dx w/ culture
grouped vesicles on an erythematous base
Warts can be single or multiple, flat, dome-shaped, cauliflower-shaped, filiform, fungating, pedunculated, cerebriform, plaque-like, smooth (esp. on penile shaft), verrucous, or lobulated
: white, skin-colored, pink or red, violaceous, brown, hyperpigmented
, induration, fixation to underlying structures, bleeding, atypical pigmentation, ulceration
